During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal organization maintained a '''fortress''' on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The leader of the faction, [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]], maintained a battalion of guards, led by his [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]], [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]].

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the facility would be [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|discovered]] by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], along with [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and his [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] forces. Maul, forming a [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]], attempted to rally the Black Sun to their cause. Grunseit refused, and as a result, Opress killed him. Moj, meanwhile, joined Maul.
